scope: Pilot audit of open technical student opportunities in Riyadh or available online from Misk and Sarj.ai.
method: A reviewer opened each official catalogue and each opportunity page independently from Nabaa, then required a visible open-registration state or application form.

reviewed_sources.notes: Official catalogue and detail pages reviewed on 2026-08-16.
Official Ashby board and application tabs reviewed on 2026-08-16.
Catalogue API was blocked by Cloudflare; indexed listings were stale and were not accepted as a complete audit.
